caption: The drawing contains three main components on a cream-colored background. In the top left corner, there is an outline of a jug or jar with a small neck and relatively wide body, depicted with a thin blue line. On this jug, there are blue floral motifs consisting of loosely painted, curved shapes, and above them, there's text in a curve that reads "Norton & Company, Bennington, VT" with a number “3” below it. Adjacent to this, on the upper right side, there is a simple outline sketch of a jug showing the neck, handle, and part of the body with no additional decorations or markings. The lower and central part of the drawing features a circular beige area with three blue, stylized flower-like shapes and swirling vine-like extensions, painted with visible brushstrokes and shading to convey depth. The flower forms use mainly blue tones ranging from dark to pale, contrasted against the muted brown background. The artist's signature appears in the bottom left corner.
title: Jug
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
